rule_text.name: 702.291a
rule_text.rule: Foreshadow represents two static abilities: one that functions on the stack and other that functions on the battlefield. "Foreshadow [cost]" means "You may cast this card by paying [cost] rather than its mana cost" and "If this spell's foreshadow cost was paid, entering the battlefield causes its abilities to trigger as though it died."
